purpose: Reconcile the CEA March-2026 >=1 MW renewable ownership population with the independently reconciled Kerala wind fleet, deriving the remaining >=1 MW solar ownership buckets without equating CEA and MNRE reporting populations.

sources.title: Resource Adequacy Plan for Transmission System of Kerala up to 2034-35
sources.role: Canonical March-2026 CEA main installed-capacity and ownership boundary

sources.publisher: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
sources.title: State-wise (Location based) installed capacity of Renewable Power as on 31.03.2026
sources.role: Independent same-date technology-category crosscheck with a different reporting schema
Wind ownership/asset decomposition reconciled from KSEBL/Economic Review sources

cea_main_boundary.description: Renewable wind+solar population included in CEA main capacity table; solar below 1 MW is reported separately by CEA.

admitted_wind_crosswalk_mw.source_note: Wind asset decomposition reconciles to Kerala Economic Review 2025; March-2026 same-date ownership change is not independently observed, so the unchanged split is an explicit bridge assumption for this structural crosswalk.

derived_solar_ge_1mw_mw.method: CEA ownership renewable total minus admitted wind ownership bucket

mnre_same_date_crosscheck.source_boundary_warning: MNRE ground/rooftop/off-grid categories are not the same population as CEA's >=1 MW versus <1 MW accounting. Do not infer CEA >=1 MW solar by subtracting CEA sub-1-MW solar from MNRE solar total.

remaining: Identify the 22.715 MW state solar >=1 MW population at plant/project level.
